title: DataStore and App File Storage Check

questions.prompt: Where should a relational article catalogue be stored?
questions.explanation: Relational queries, indices, partial updates, and integrity need a database.

questions.prompt: Cache files are suitable as the only copy of user-created data.
questions.explanation: Cache storage is reclaimable and contains only reconstructable bytes.

questions.prompt: What must a DataStore update transformation avoid?
questions.explanation: The atomic transform may be evaluated again and should remain pure.
